name: Suillus luteus
notes: Long-distance exploration type [13]; native to EU and AS, invasive with pine in SA, AF and AU. Ectomycorrhizal isolates including Suillus grew 0.25 to 0.95 mm/day on agar at 22 C [25], a group figure that is not entered as this species' tip speed. Its relative S. bovinus is reported (unchecked) to be the classic species in root-window microcosms showing carbon moving between seedlings.

t_opt.note: 22 C suited Suillus isolates in one study (research/08 [25], snippet); genus level, not a measured optimum
